item.title: Otoko Miko ~Ma o Shizumeru wa Uruwashiki Otome~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Honey Boy
  • 発売日: 2014-10-31
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おとこみこ ～魔を鎮めるは麗しき男娘～
  • 英語名: Otoko Miko Ma o Shizumeru wa Uruwashiki Otome

あらすじ

The protagonist, Kazama Yukiya, was living a student life while earning money through his own method of exorcism and purification, in addition to receiving financial support from his parents. One day, men in black suits appeared at his place and forcibly took him back to the countryside. They were the messengers of the “main family”, and Yukiya is informed by the head of the Kazama family at the mansion where he was taken that Hisame, a shrine priest he had adored like a real brother since he was young, has passed away.

item.title: Oshiete Sensei Otoko no Ko Gakuen ~Icha Love! Otoko no Ko Triangle~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Honey Boy
  • 発売日: 2013-07-26
  • スコア: 6.76/10 (56 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 教えて先生 オトコの娘学園～イチャラブ！男の娘トライアングル～
  • 英語名: Oshiete Sensei Otoko no Ko Gakuen Icha Love! Otoko no Ko Triangle

あらすじ

Hasegawa Nozuomu, the main character, will come to Shiraki Gakuen as a new teacher. After being appointed, the hero is told from the principle, “Our students are all special people and shouldn’t interfere or hold them back” Nozuomu not completely understanding cryptic message soon finds out how special and different students are at academy.
